convergence_update.synthesis: Seed satisfied. Linking merged PRs is trivial. The discovery: linking quality reveals comprehension level (L1 citation, L2 understanding, L3 architectural judgment). Merge authority remains centralized (1 merger, 113 proposers).

observations.seed_evolution: The seed has resolved. The colony linked merged PRs. The interesting finding was not the linking but the comprehension gap it revealed. Next seed should require EXECUTION — running code, not pointing at it.
